defect: None; the fix renames addLocalIndizesOfPatchSide to addLocalIndicesOfPatchSide across the module.
reason: Line 325 calls the method under its existing name (declared that way in gsMappedBasis.h at 4eb5a06), and the block is commented out. The fix is a spelling rename refactor.

defect: basisSlice dynamic_casts boundaryBasis() to a 1-D tensor basis (wrong for d>2) and leaks the returned boundary basis.
reason: The dynamic_cast to gsTensorBSplineBasis<1,...> and the leak were already in the parent. This change only added const and typename.

defect: In maxEigenvalue the ternaries mix T and int (`cond ? math::abs(..) : 0`), which fails to compile for non-double scalar types such as GMP/MPFR reals.
reason: The Gerschgorin loop with `: 0` branches is new code in this commit (the parent used a different loop). The fix changes both branches to T(0).

defect: gsBSpline::insertKnot(T,index_t) is ambiguous with the gsGeometry::insertKnot(T,index_t,index_t=1) overload brought in by `using Base::insertKnot`.
reason: The ambiguity was already there in parent 115613e (int == index_t in the default build). Changing int to index_t was an incomplete attempt at it, and the fix restructures the overloads.

defect: slice() names gsTensorBSpline<d-1,T>. The same commit adds explicit full-class instantiations for d=1, so gsTensorBSpline<0,T> gets instantiated and the build fails.
reason: The commit moves slice into the .hpp and adds `CLASS_TEMPLATE_INST gsTensorBSpline<1,...>` in _.cpp; before, only gsXml was instantiated. The fix changes slice to use BoundaryGeometry/gsTraits so d does not go down to 0.

defect: The fix changes gsInvDiagonalOp::make to return a base-class shared LinOpPtr instead of uPtr.
reason: The real compile break (typedefs still naming the removed gsDiagonalOp) was fixed by intermediate commits 7c6fc7c/93f63c3. The fix's change to line 794 is an API/design change inside a feature commit.

defect: interpolateGrid now returns memory::unique_ptr but still does `return 0;` in the debug-only failure branch, which does not compile with the C++98 unique_ptr emulation (explicit constructor).
reason: This change made the return type at line 909 a unique_ptr. The fix replaces `return 0` with `return typename gsGeometry<T>::uPtr();`.

defect: Autodiff branches are guarded by GISMO_USE_AUTODIFF instead of the build macro GISMO_WITH_ADIFF.
reason: The parent already used GISMO_USE_AUTODIFF. The fix renames it to follow a later config macro rename, so the defect is not new in this change.

defect: The function-local static MPI singleton in a header can be duplicated across shared libraries; the fix moves it into an exported function.
reason: The singleton design came from the parent. This change only const-qualified argc and swapped assert for GISMO_ASSERT. The fix is a redesign (exported singleton, ENSURE).

defect: std::max(T, double) with std::pow(10.0, ...) cannot deduce a single type when T is not double (for example long double), so it fails to compile.
reason: This change added the std::max/std::pow(10.0,...) line. The fix changes it to std::pow(T(10.0), ...) under the subject 'support long double'.

defect: reshape_expr asserts on _u.rows()/cols() in the constructor before data exists, and eval returns a reshape map of the temporary returned by _u.eval(k), which dangles.
reason: This commit added reshape_expr. The fix moves the assertion into eval and copies into a member tmp before returning a gsAsConstMatrix view of it.

defect: The assertion nDofs==basis size is too strict once mappers may carry extra dofs.
reason: The strict assertion matched the code at the time. A later dG-IETI branch added mappers with more dofs (the status |= 2 path), and the fix adapts the assertion to that new feature.

defect: gsCompositionAd registration keys the outer function on innerLeft data instead of on the innerLeft∘innerRight composition, so F∘GLeft∘GRight is computed wrongly.
reason: The parent was already wrong the same way (it keyed on m_fdata[innerLeft]). This WIP commit swapped one wrong key for another, and the fix rewrites the registration.

defect: None; the serial loop has a redundant `&& (!failed)` check.
reason: Without OpenMP the catch already breaks out of the loop, so the extra condition is harmless. The fix only removes it, a cleanup.

defect: dSigmadAlpha.conservativeResize(nControls,2) is used as a reshape, but conservativeResize keeps entries by (row,col) and does not reinterpret the column-major data, so dEdAlpha is wrong.
reason: This commit added the conservativeResize line. The fix replaces it with an Eigen::Map of the data as nControls x 2.

defect: A leftover debug print of axisOrientation.
reason: The fix only removes a gsInfo debug output. Behavior is not otherwise wrong.

defect: clear() now resets m_dim=-1 and nboxes=0, but gsMultiPatch::computeTopology calls clear() and then uses m_dim (1<<m_dim, coor(m_dim,...)), so it breaks.
reason: This change added the two reset lines, and the fix removes them the next day. The caller is in gsMultiPatch.hpp.

defect: `reducedG1BasisEdgeMap[numG1EdgeBasis[i-1]] == 0 || i == 0` evaluates numG1EdgeBasis[i-1] with size_t i==0 (out of bounds) before the i==0 test. The i==0 branch also overwrites entries already set via an interface.
reason: reducedBasisEdgeMapper is new in this commit. The fix tests i==0 first and adds the already-mapped check for edge 0.

defect: The generic grad(divide_expr<E1,E2>) overload is too broad and collides with the constant-numerator/denominator specializations; the fix restricts it to divide_expr<_expr<E1,false>,E2>.
reason: The same overload set already existed with `auto` return types in the parent. This change only spelled out return types, so it is unclear whether it introduced the ambiguity.

defect: The inexact MINRES residual estimate multiplies the residual norm by s^2 instead of |s|.
reason: `m_error *= sNew*sNew` was already in the parent. This commit only reordered the statements.

defect: For multiple patches, m_numFreeDofs is multiplied by nPatches although m_offset.back()+last size is already the total.
reason: The `*nPatches` factor was in the parent. This change only fixed numComp to numComp+1.

defect: The outer-normal sign uses det(J) at each point, which flips at singular or near-zero-determinant boundary points.
reason: The per-point det sign logic was moved unchanged from the parent's outer-normal block. The fix adds a robust sign determination.

defect: None in line 824; the fix keeps `m_fixedDofs.at(global_to_bindex(ii))` and only reformats it.
reason: The blamed line is only touched incidentally (braces and spacing). The real fix is in corner-value code on other lines.

defect: The explicit specialization gsXml<gsOptionList> was moved from the header into the .cpp, so users such as gsCmdLine.h see only the primary template, which breaks the build and violates the ODR.
reason: This commit moved the specialization out of gsOptionList.h. The fix moves it back to the header 30 minutes later.

defect: Replacing the size() override with `using Base::size;` in gsTensorBasis<1,T> fails to compile on MSVC 2010.
reason: This change added `using Base::size` and removed size(). The fix ('bugfix msvc2010') replaces it with a pure virtual size() declaration.

defect: After renaming the local to _temp, leftover uses of `temp` still refer to the old name.
reason: The incomplete rename was introduced by the later commit 2845043 ('warn fix'), not by 926908c. This change's own defects (str::string typo, free() on a getenv pointer) are not what this fix repairs.

defect: The manualLevels flag is not stored as a member or copied.
reason: The fix adds m_manualLevels and m_uIndices to support the developing addLevel feature. This is feature work, not repair of a defect in line 119.

defect: Leftover gsDebugVar debug output, one of which runs an extra evaluation.
reason: Blamed lines 136/146/159/164 are debug prints that the fix removes. The real Dirichlet fixes are on other lines.

defect: The explicit instantiations of gsKnotRemove/gsTensorKnotRemove use index_t and gsVector<index_t>, but the templates in gsBoehm.h declare int and gsVector<unsigned>, so the instantiations match no template.
reason: This commit added both the declarations and the mismatched instantiations. The fix changes the instantiation signatures to int and gsVector<unsigned>.

defect: The new assertion `2*p+1 > sz` is inverted; a valid knot vector needs sz > 2p+1, so every valid construction fails it.
reason: This change added the assertion, and the fix flips it to `<` the same day.

defect: The added return statement uses the nonexistent type gsMatrix<T>::uPt instead of uPtr, so the template fails to compile when instantiated.
reason: The change added `return gsMatrix<T>::uPt(res);` and the fix corrects only that typo to `uPtr`. The function's declared return type `typename gsMatrix<T>::uPtr` is a few lines above it in the diff.

defect: printSparsity uses the invalid escape sequence "\%", which compilers only warn about and still print as '%'.
reason: The fix replaces "\%" with '%'. That is a warning or style cleanup: the output does not change, and the line still prints size() labelled as nnz.

defect: testEval prints an extra newline before 'Result:'.
reason: The fix only drops the leading \n in the output string, which is purely cosmetic.

defect: For surfaces, outerNormal crosses the tangent with the unnormalized normal t1 x t2, so the outer normal has the wrong magnitude, and the computed normalizedRes goes unused.
reason: The change replaced `normalizedRes.cross(signJk)` with `signJk.cross(n)`, where n = t1.cross(t2) is never normalized (the normalization line is commented out). The fix restores `signJk.cross(normalizedRes)` and removes the t1/t2/n lines.

defect: The explicit-instantiation macros were later renamed (*_EINST) under _MSC_VER as part of a redesign of extern templates.
reason: The fix comes 48 days later, after the macro block had been restructured under #ifdef _MSC_VER. It only renames the macros for the extern-template scheme, so the blamed lines are touched by a refactor, not a bug repair.

defect: The new demangling code calls the unqualified free(dm) without including <cstdlib>, which fails to compile on some C++11 configurations.
reason: The change added `free(dm);` and the fix ('Fixed bug related to C++11') changes it to `std::free(dm);`. The diff shows the header includes only <sstream> and <numeric>.

defect: The new elementInSupportOf indexes the d x 2 support matrix as sup(0,i)/sup(1,i) (transposed) and takes the max instead of the min for the upper corner, so the box intersection is wrong.
reason: The fix changes sup(0,i)/sup(1,i) to sup(i,0)/sup(i,1) and `>=` to `<=` for box.second, all in lines this change added. The same function uses sup.col(0)/col(1), so the inconsistency is visible.

defect: An experimental swap() with hard-coded patch indices was added and later removed.
reason: The fix simply deletes the test helper ('Some test' / 'Fixed'). It is a change of mind about experimental code, not a repair of a demonstrated defect.

defect: Reading <cv> nodes now requires a 'component' attribute and dereferences first_attribute("component") without a null check, so existing XML files without it crash.
reason: The change added `atoi(child->first_attribute("component")->value())`, and the fix makes component optional with a NULL check (default -1). The <bc> parsing just above in the diff already treats component as optional.

defect: The added preprocessor block starts with the invalid directive `#ifcc`, which breaks compilation whenever _OPENMP is defined.
reason: The change introduced `#ifcc _OPENMP >= 202111`, and the fix replaces the invalid directive (with `#ifdef`, which is itself still dubious).

defect: The ratio functions' namespace later mismatched their calls (utils::ratio) after an intermediate rename.
reason: At 57f1f6e the header declares ratio in namespace benchmark, which matches the .cpp. The mismatch fixed by 3c2ac14 was introduced by the later commit c1895d2 'Replaced benchmark namespace by utils'.

defect: The new addLevel gives every inserted knot in the same span the index dirIndices[i]+1, so with more than one new knot per span the level indices are duplicated or wrong.
reason: The fix rewrites the extra-index computation in the newly added function: it counts the knots per span, picks a middle or first index, and inserts the knots one at a time. A reviewer can see that all knots in one span map to the same index.

defect: Changing the general overload to grad(divide_expr<_expr<E1,false>,E2>) makes it ambiguous with the adjacent grad(divide_expr<E1,_expr<Scalar,true>>) overload when dividing by a constant.
reason: The fix, by the same author 10 minutes later, further restricts the second argument to _expr<E2,false> in exactly the modified line, which removes the overlap with the next overload shown in the diff.

defect: toVTK calls funSet.basis(i).support(), which static_casts each piece to gsBasis; for a geometry or multipatch function set that is an invalid cast (UB or assert).
reason: The fix replaces basis(i).support() with piece(i).support() in the newly added toVTK. Spotting it requires knowing that gsFunctionSet::basis(k) casts piece(k) to gsBasis.

defect: After a later restructuring, matchWith's dynamic_cast to Self_t no longer matched the tensor 1-D class.
reason: At dfe605b, Self_t is gsBSplineBasis itself, so the cast is correct. The mismatch arose from later restructuring commits (40284bc etc.) that moved the code into gsTensorBSplineBasis<1>.

defect: BoundaryGeometryType and BoundaryBasisType are hard-coded to dimension 1 instead of d-1, which is wrong for d != 2 and breaks slice/boundary for 3D.
reason: The change added `typedef gsHBSpline<1,T> BoundaryGeometryType; typedef gsHBSplineBasis<1,T> BoundaryBasisType;` in a class templated on d, and the fix changes both to d-1.

defect: `"Unknown-CPU ["+hostname+"]"` adds a string literal and a char array (pointer + pointer), which does not compile.
reason: The change added that return statement, and the fix builds the string with std::string concatenation instead.

defect: next() calls nextLeaf() when nextLexicographic succeeded instead of when it failed, so the iterator skips elements and leaves.
reason: The change rewrote next() as `if (isGood) isGood = nextLeaf();`, and the fix inverts it to `if (!isGood)`. The removed else branch and the comment in the diff show the intended logic.

defect: The density builder copies elwiseERROR into errorVector assuming that degree-0 basis index equals element index, and clamps instead of marking.
reason: The fix is a broad redesign (basis_0 from n_basis, marking via domain-iterator ids, a new rho coefficient). The index-ordering assumption already existed in the parent's neighborhood-averaging code.

defect: For MinGW, the change includes <intrin.h>; the fix includes <cpuid.h> for GNUC instead and also replaces HOST_NAME_MAX.
reason: Whether <intrin.h> actually broke the MinGW build cannot be seen; the fix looks like a platform-portability change of approach rather than a clear repair of the added lines.

defect: The boundary clamp in the composed-map eval hard-codes a 2-component point and only handles u2 near 1, so 3D compositions and the other sides still evaluate wrongly (NaN); debug output is also left in.
reason: The fix sizes tmp2 by parDim(), handles all sides for 2D and 3D, and removes the debug prints, replacing exactly the lines this change added.

defect: No defect in the std::max to math::max replacement; the fix only reformats those lines.
reason: In the #713 fix the blamed math::max/min lines reappear unchanged apart from indentation and uv.at() style. The actual bug fixes there are elsewhere.

defect: No defect in the added curvatureTolerance parameter; the fix restyles the intersect body.
reason: The blamed getPotentialIntersectionRanges(...,curvatureTolerance) line is kept semantically identical in the fix, which only reformats it and changes uv to gsVector.

defect: The fix changes dfunc2->eval_into to deriv_into.
reason: The parent already called dfunc2->eval_into; the change only added the f2param ternary, so the repaired call predates this change.

defect: evaluate calls _func2.deriv_into on physical points, but the caller supplies func2 as the exact gradient, so eval_into is needed (debug print also left in).
reason: deriv_into was already used in the parent (with the f2param ternary). Whether the change of caller semantics happened in this commit cannot be seen from this file.

defect: computeAuxiliaryData sizes and branches with static domDim/tarDim, which is wrong for dynamic (-1) dimensions.
reason: The blamed resize line only renamed jacInv to jacInvTr; the domDim*tarDim sizing the fix corrects existed in the parent.

defect: insertKnot accesses a nonexistent m_weights member (now tbs.m_weights on the B-spline basis), so it cannot compile when instantiated.
reason: The parent already used the nonexistent this->m_weights in the same function, so insertKnot was already broken; this change only partially reworked it.

defect: thValue is declared outside #ifdef _OPENMP, so it is unused in non-OpenMP builds.
reason: The fix only moves #endif after thValue, which removes an unused-variable warning. The change itself repaired a broken merge.

defect: The new breakPolylineIntoTwoParts uses the alternative token `and` (`!p1 and !p2`), which MSVC rejects by default.
reason: The change added that line and the fix replaces `and` with `&&` ('does not affect gcc'), a compile error on a supported compiler.

defect: `gsQuadRule<T> & QuRule = *gsQuadrature::getPtr(...)` binds a reference into a temporary unique_ptr that is destroyed at the end of the statement, leaving a dangling reference (use after free).
reason: The fix stores the returned uPtr in a local and uses QuRule->. Seeing the bug requires knowing that getPtr returns an owning uPtr.

defect: The stiffness contribution is built from the parametric gradients basisGrads instead of the physical gradients basisPhGrads, so the geometry map is ignored.
reason: The file is new in this commit. The fix replaces basisGrads.transpose()*basisGrads with basisPhGrads.transpose()*basisPhGrads. basisPhGrads is computed one line earlier and never used, which a reviewer can see in the diff.

defect: No defect; the change only swaps double for T in the constructor signatures, and the fix merges the constructors into an options-based init().
reason: The blamed lines 41/44 are incidentally rewritten by a refactor that adds an options constructor and a default fixDir. That refactor does not repair anything in the double-to-T change.

defect: getOuterNormalDerivative picks supp(d,0) when corners[i].parameters(dim)[d] is true, so it evaluates the Jacobian at the opposite corner (true means the upper end); its default eps is also too tight.
reason: The function is new in this commit. The fix swaps it to parameters[d] ? supp(d,1) : supp(d,0) (and sets eps to 1e-4). Seeing the inversion requires the patchCorner::parameters convention from gsBoundary.h.

defect: The OpenMP 4.0 'declare reduction' in closestPointTo does not compile with MSVC; the fix wraps it in #ifndef _MSC_VER.
reason: The declare reduction pragma already existed in the parent. This change only renamed the struct and made tmp private (a fix in itself), so the MSVC incompatibility predates it.

defect: The added early return (objective < 1e-5) was a TODO workaround that the fix removes once it repairs the actual cause, a 'static const space' in gradObj_into.
reason: The real defect the fix repairs (the static space1 caching the first mapper) was in pre-existing code. Removing the workaround block is a change of mind, not a repair of a wrong result introduced here.

defect: The fix renames boundary()/boundary(s,offset) to allBoundary()/boundaryOffset() to follow an interface rename made in c5f4b04.
reason: The blamed lines are only touched by a follow-up rename. The offset logic added here (offset, size-p-2-offset) is unchanged by the fix.

defect: No defect; the fix only reformats the 'if (isEnd) nL2 = copy.numCoefs();' line.
reason: Fix e235a49 is a type and style cleanup. Line 117 keeps the same semantics.

defect: jacobian_into reshapes the deriv_into output (layout c*parDim+j per point) to tarDim rows and block-transposes with domainDim(), which scrambles the Jacobian whenever domainDim != targetDim.
reason: The rewritten jacobian_into is new in this commit. The fix resizes to domainDim() rows and block-transposes by targetDim(). The deriv_into layout is shown in the same diff.

defect: The fix makes the Intel compiler always use boost and uses std::shared_ptr in C++11 mode with libstdc++ instead of tr1.
reason: tr1 under libstdc++ in C++11 mode was already the parent's behaviour. The fix is a configuration preference plus a new unique_ptr conversion, not a repair of a defect this change added.

defect: The interior-knot correction counts 3 extra functions only when m_p-1-m_r==1, which gives the wrong number of basis functions for other degree/regularity/multiplicity combinations.
reason: The numInnerKnot logic is new in this commit. The fix generalizes the condition to m_p-m_r < innerKnotMulti+1 with count 3*(m_r-1). Knowing the right count takes domain theory or running it.

defect: '#define inout MPI_IN_PLACE' has the macro reversed: it should define MPI_IN_PLACE as inout, so the masking never provides MPI_IN_PLACE and instead rewrites the parameter name inout.
reason: The block is added in this commit. The fix changes it to '#define MPI_IN_PLACE inout'. The later '#undef MPI_IN_PLACE' in the same diff shows the intent.

defect: The default active_into calls result.setConstant(0,u.cols()), with the arguments in the wrong order, instead of building a 1 x cols matrix of zeros.
reason: The file is new and the code did not exist in the parent. The fix changes the call to setConstant(1,u.cols(),0). The comment 'single function 0 is active' next to it makes the misuse visible.

defect: No defect in the blamed lines; the fix removes leftover gsDebugVar output from _makeUnique (and restores copy/move operators elsewhere).
reason: Lines 593-607 are debug prints that the 'fixed leak' commit merely deletes, which is a style cleanup.

defect: The fix drops the embed(D-1) and the identity-map setup in basis_data while the function evolves into a real mapping.
reason: embed(D-1) was moved verbatim from laplace_beltrami in the parent. The identity map was a placeholder that was replaced, not a wrong result.

defect: The blamed '#include <direct.h>' is later removed as an unused inclusion.
reason: The fix message says 'remove unused inclusion'. Removing an unused include is cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: A leftover gsInfo debug print, plus an exact [0,1] bound that the fix replaces with a 1e-8 tolerance.
reason: The debug print is style. The exact bound check (0<=iparam<=norm) was already exact in the parent, so the added tolerance is a behaviour tweak to pre-existing logic.

defect: A semicolon is missing after 'typename gsPde<T>::Ptr pde(new gsLinpLapPde<T>(...))', which is a compile error.
reason: The file is new in this commit. The fix only adds the semicolon on line 106.

defect: clone() passes *piece(i).clone() to addPiece, which clones again, so every intermediate clone leaks.
reason: clone() is added in this commit. The fix passes piece(i) directly. addPiece's body (push_back(func.clone())) is in the shown context.

defect: geoMap2vtk writes point coordinates using n (the number of patches) as the coordinate count instead of pts.rows(), and shadows the outer loop variable i.
reason: geoMap2vtk is new in this commit. The fix replaces n with pts.rows() in both inner loops. The diff shows n = nBases().

defect: elementInSupportOf is declared a second time in gsRationalBasis (it already exists at line 148), which is a redeclaration compile error.
reason: The fix deletes exactly the duplicate line this commit added. The earlier declaration at line 148 is outside the 30-line context shown.

defect: std::free is called on the pointer returned by getenv, which the program does not own, so the call is undefined behaviour and can crash.
reason: This commit uncommented free(_temp) after getenv. The fix removes it ('env variable needs no free'). The getenv calls are in the shown context.

defect: A leftover debug print 'here w eare' to std::cout in refineWithExtension.
reason: The fix only deletes the debug output, which is a style issue and not a wrong result.

defect: helper() uses 0 as both the 'unset' sentinel and a valid (patch, local index), and sizes 'which' by the global patchSize while indexing it by local free indices, so entries can go out of bounds or map wrong.
reason: helper() is new in this commit. The fix shifts the stored indices by +1/-1, asserts the result is >= 0, and sizes 'which' by m_dofMapperLocal[otherPatch].freeSize(). This requires the dof mapper semantics.

defect: The header uses real_t without including its definition; the fix swaps gsExport.h/<map> for gsForwardDeclarations.h.
reason: Every includer (gismo.h, gsCmdLine.cpp) already defines real_t first, so no supported build failed. The fix is header hygiene.

defect: No defect; the fix restyles the toBezier loop braces and indentation.
reason: Line 140 changes only in formatting under the type and style cleanup e235a49.

defect: No defect; the fix reformats the intersect() signature line.
reason: Line 152 is only re-wrapped. The bug fixes in e235a49 (uv type, the return in getPotentialIntersectionRanges) are on other lines or in other files.

defect: Dropping const from eval_into's input parameter means it no longer overrides gsFunction::eval_into(const gsMatrix&, gsMatrix&) const.
reason: This commit removed the const. The fix restores it, 7 minutes later. The diff shows a virtual override's signature being changed.

defect: apply1 clears m_elWise on each call, so a caller that loops over boundary sides keeps only the element values of the last side.
reason: apply1 is new in this commit. The fix removes the clear and moves it into gsNormL2Boundary::compute, before the loop over sides. Seeing it needs that caller.

defect: The intersection's upper bound uses >= (a max) where a min is needed, plus leftover gsDebugVar lines.
reason: The wrong >= on box.second already existed in the parent. This change only fixed the sup(0,i) to sup(i,0) indexing and added debug prints.

defect: The numPoints constructor computes npts[i] = span[i]/(h*wght[i]) = span.sum()/h, which is the same count in every direction and far more than numPoints in total.
reason: The file is new in this commit. The fix 'fix point count' replaces the formula with an n^(1/d) scaling by the span. The algebra is visible in the shown code.

defect: The binding casts computeTopology to (real_t,bool,bool), but a later header change dropped the third parameter.
reason: At 0f6253a gsMultiPatch.h declares computeTopology(T,bool,bool), so the change was correct. The fix only follows a later header revert that commented out tjunctions.

defect: deriv2Single_into tests isTruncated(i) instead of !isTruncated(i), so the condition is inverted and truncated functions take the plain tensor branch.
reason: The change rewrote `m_is_truncated[i] == -1` as `isTruncated(i)` without the negation, while evalSingle_into in the same diff correctly uses `!isTruncated(i)`. The fix adds the `!` back.

defect: The new expr+scalar operators build add_expr<_expr<Scalar>,E> but pass the operands in the wrong order, and they use the non-constant _expr<Scalar> instead of _expr<Scalar,true>, so the operator is ill-typed.
reason: The blamed operator+ overloads were rewritten in this change. The fix, made 0.1 days later, corrects the template arguments to <E,_expr<Scalar,true>> and the argument order.

defect: The fix only drops the quotes from the new #warning text and touches whitespace.
reason: `#warning "..."` is valid, so the fix is cosmetic. The `#define inout MPI_IN_PLACE` swap it also repairs predates this change. The real defect this change added, a stray extra #endif, was removed by a different commit (3f66d2bfd).

defect: constructSolution now takes dim from solVector.cols(), so when there are no free dofs (an empty solution vector) dim is 0 and the coefficients get the wrong width.
reason: The change replaced numRhs() with solVector.cols(). The fix ('fix for no free dofs', same day) falls back to m_ddof[unk].cols() when cols()==0.

defect: CG does not exit early when the initial guess is already exact, so the zero residual makes alpha divide by zero.
reason: The parent had the same flow (absNew = 0 then a division). This commit only renamed variables, and the fix adds a new early-convergence check.

defect: The header declares ratio() in namespace utils, but gsBenchmark.cpp still defines it in namespace benchmark, so the exported utils::ratio functions are never defined and calls to them fail to link.
reason: At c1895d2 gsBenchmark.cpp lines 312/356 still say `namespace benchmark` while the header and callers use `utils::`. The fix unifies header and cpp on `util`.

defect: The new filter in get() tests `c->m_unkcomp == -1` instead of `comp == -1`, so the default call (comp=-1, meaning all components) drops every component-specific condition.
reason: The blamed condition was added in this change. The fix replaces `c->m_unkcomp == -1` with `comp == -1`.

defect: degreeReduce is applied before the uniform-refinement loop instead of after it.
reason: The fix only reorders the degree reduction and the message print; the substantive fix is in buildDensity. The reorder looks like a design tweak in research code rather than a clear defect.

defect: Mesh-boundary vertices shared by 2 or more patches are now mapped to the average of the inner (1,1) DOFs instead of a free DOF, so Dirichlet elimination constrains only the sum of the inner DOFs and the second control-point row escapes.
reason: The change removed the is_boundary early branch that gave a free DOF and added the `face_count >= 2` averaging. The fix, 0.9 days later, restores a shared free DOF per boundary vertex.

defect: gsRefineMarkedFunctions only handles patch 0: it counts marks only over patch 0's functions, then loops over the whole funMarked vector calling basis(0).support(i), which overflows refBoxes and indexes out of range for multipatch input.
reason: The blamed lines are the new function body. The fix rewrites it to loop per patch with offsets; the TODO in the change shows the multipatch case was missing.

defect: An unused local `CMatrix cmat;` is shadowed by the per-level reference inside the loop.
reason: The fix only deletes the unused variable and renames shadowed variables, which is warning cleanup with no behaviour change.

defect: The new gsField toVTK builds its grid from field.fields().basis(i).support(); for a multipatch or non-parametric field, piece(i) is not a gsBasis, so gsFunctionSet::basis() static_casts it wrongly.
reason: The gsField overload is new in this change (its body copies the existing pattern). The fix switches it to piece(i).support(). Spotting it needs the gsFunctionSet::basis() contract (a cast to gsBasis).

defect: The change replaced four case labels with the GNU case-range extension `case 1 ... 4:`, which MSVC does not compile.
reason: The parent had separate case 1..4 labels and this commit merged them into the range syntax. The fix ('fix syntax') restores the four labels.

defect: The new degreeDecrease lowers m_p but calls increaseMultFirst/Last, copied from degreeIncrease, so it increases the end multiplicities instead of trimming them.
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix replaces the two calls with trim(i). The copy-paste error is plain in the diff next to degreeIncrease.

defect: The fix moves the sign declaration and indexes the 1-by-dim val as val(0,i) instead of val(i).
reason: val(i) linear indexing on a 1-row matrix is valid Eigen and the parent used it too. The fix is cosmetic and does not change behaviour.

defect: The new templated pushSparse iterates a gsSparseMatrix<T> with gsSparseMatrix<double>::InnerIterator, so it fails to compile when T is not double.
reason: pushSparse (signature `const gsSparseMatrix<T> & localMat`) was added in this change. The fix uses `typename gsSparseMatrix<T>::iterator`.

defect: The blamed lines are added gsDebugVar debug prints; the substantive bugs the fix repairs (i==com instead of i==dir, fixedDofs(ii,r) indexing) were already there.
reason: The lines this change added are only debug output, which the fix removes. The functional fixes touch lines from earlier commits.

defect: A corner-value block in gsFeSpace::setup duplicates the corner handling already done in gsDirichletValues.
reason: The change only corrected the bindex arguments to (i,patch,component), which matches the 3-argument signature. The fix deletes the whole block, which predates this change.

defect: The surface objective uses the penalty-regularised chi = 0.5*(detG+sqrt(eps^2+detG^2)).
reason: The fix ('remove penalty from gsAdaptiveParametrization') replaces chi by detG and keeps the old option commented out, which is a modelling change of mind, not a bug fix.

defect: Later the copy constructor sets dim after addComponent instead of calling init(dim) first.
reason: This change correctly added copying of dim. The fix, 34 days later, edits a rewritten copy constructor, so the blamed line is only incidentally related.

defect: The auto_ptr refactor added `typename` to the explicit-instantiation declarations, which are not templates (T is a macro for real_t), so they are ill-formed before C++11.
reason: The blamed lines are exactly the new `const typename gsGeometryEvaluator<T>::uPtr` and `typename gsBasis<T>::domainIter` parameters. The fix ('no typename outside of templates') removes them.

defect: getCoeffs now assigns result.row(i) = solVector.row(ii) inside the per-component loop; for vector spaces (dim>1) result has dim columns while solVector is a single column, so the sizes mismatch.
reason: The change replaced `result(i,c) = solVector.at(ii)` with the row assignment. The fix restores the scalar assignment, citing the Kirchhoff-Love crash.

defect: assembleTensorStiffness_impl reinterpret_casts any gsBasis to gsTensorNurbsBasis without a check (replacing the checked dynamic_cast to gsTensorBasis), which is undefined behaviour for B-spline tensor bases; mass assembly uses exceptions for control flow.
reason: The parent used a checked dynamic_cast to gsTensorBasis. The fix removes the reinterpret_cast and the try/catch and calls basis.component() directly.

defect: A library header includes the umbrella <gismo.h>.
reason: The fix only removes the include and changes another include from quotes to angle brackets, which is header hygiene with no demonstrated wrong result or build failure.

defect: The OpenMP reduction is declared for `struct closestPointHelper` while the variable is `__closestPointHelper` (a compile error with OpenMP), and the scratch vector tmp is shared across threads, which is a data race.
reason: closestPointTo was added in this change. The fix, the same day, corrects the struct name in the declare-reduction and makes tmp private.

defect: The change dropped the gsDofMapper.h include although the class uses gsDofMapper, and it named a local `map`; the fix re-adds the include, renames the variable and removes the now-dead mapGaussNodes.
reason: The fix ('should fix last wrong commits', same day) suggests the build broke. Most blamed lines are only removed as dead code, and whether the missing include actually failed to compile depends on include order in other files.

defect: The new coefficient scaling sums both patch coefficients into one field and uses (sum-rho_k)/rho_k, which gives the inverted weight rho_k/(rho_k+rho_j) and breaks at corners where more than two patches meet.
reason: setupCoefficientScaling is new in this 'first attempt'. The fix stores the neighbour patch per row and uses coef[k]/coef[other] ('works now for 2d with corner primals'). Seeing that the weight is inverted needs FETI-DP scaling theory.

defect: The duplicate vertex pointers dropped by sort/unique/erase are never freed, so they leak.
reason: The parent already erased the unique() tail without freeing it. This change only moved the erase and added debug prints, and the fix replaces the whole thing with cleanStlMesh().

defect: np2 is computed as (np.size()>1 ? np(2)-1 : 0), so for 2D grids it reads np(2) out of bounds.
reason: The line was added in this change, replacing the correct inline `np.size()>2` check. The fix changes the condition to >2.

defect: New pruned() uses a bare deduced 'auto' return type (and captures the by-value tol by reference into a returned lazy expression), which the fix says broke a C++14 build.
reason: The fix only adds '-> decltype(auto)' to the line this change added; it is unclear which supported compiler failed, and the dangling capture of tol is not what the fix touches.

defect: Prefixing './' to paths that are neither explicitly relative nor absolute; the fix later comments the whole prefixing logic out.
reason: The real breakage came from 5d90b33, which replaced './' with getCurrentPath(); this commit's condition line is only incidentally commented out by the fix.

defect: isBoundary()/checkBoundary() were empty stubs and isBdy was hardcoded to {true,true} for every patch.
reason: The fix completes work-in-progress placeholders with a real boundary-detection feature (checkBoundary, swapBdy); this is feature completion, not repair of a regression.

defect: The two new addCornerValue overloads (int p, boxCorner c, T v, int unk) and (boxCorner c, T v, int unk) are ambiguous for natural calls because boxCorner converts implicitly to/from integers and enums.
reason: The fix merges the two overloads this change added into a single addCornerValue(boxCorner, T, int p=0, int unknown=0); seeing the ambiguity requires knowing boxCorner's implicit conversions in gsBoundary.h.

defect: allComponents indexes it->second[i] with the outer loop index instead of j, and never pushes 'last' into result.
reason: The fix changes [i] to [j] and adds result.push_back(last) in the loop this change added; both are visible in the diff.

defect: The constructor hardcodes m_dbd={0}, so apply() always overwrites row 0 of the product with the input, which gives wrong products for every Kronecker matrix.
reason: The fix removes the hardcoded m_dbd.resize(1); m_dbd(0)=0 (blamed line 204) that this change added and replaces it with setUnitDiagonals().

defect: slice() is declared with gsTensorBSpline<d-1,T>, which instantiates gsTensorBSpline<0,T> for d==1 and breaks compilation of 1D tensor B-splines.
reason: The fix replaces the d-1 type in the slice declaration this change added with a BoundaryGeometry typedef clamped at d==1.

defect: hessian_into for dim==1 was changed to result = secDers.transpose(), which ignores coord and gives a numPts x targetDim shape instead of 1 x numPts.
reason: The fix's main repair (computeAuxiliaryData dynamic-dimension conditions) is in code that existed before this change; the blamed transpose line is only replaced as part of a refactor to util::secDerToHessian.

defect: The corner-value block in gsFeSpace setup duplicated corner handling and used it->component, which may be -1.
reason: The block existed before; this change only fixed the bindex argument list, and the fix deletes the whole pre-existing block, so the blamed line is touched only incidentally.

defect: The pybind static_cast to bool(Class::*)(real_t,bool) for computeTopology no longer matched once a third parameter was added.
reason: At 0fe3e14 computeTopology(T,bool) matched the cast; the mismatch came from the later 5c69478 (tjunctions flag), so this change did not introduce the defect.

defect: solGrad_expr's fixed-DoF branch was changed to res.row(c) += fixedPart().at(bindex)*grad, which the fix reverts to the row-wise asDiagonal/replicate form.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the lines this change modified, but it is unclear which is correct for the fixedPart layout, so this may be a change of mind rather than a repaired defect.

defect: The pybind cast to gsMatrix<real_t>(Class::*)(int) const matches no greville overload (greville(int) returns T, and the matrix version takes bool), so the Python build fails to compile.
reason: The fix changes the cast this change introduced to (bool) with a clamp argument; the mismatch is only visible from gsKnotVector.h's signatures.

defect: insertKnot uses this->m_weights, which gsTensorNurbs does not have (weights live in the basis), and calls basis() helpers on the rational basis, so it does not compile when instantiated.
reason: Within hours the fix rewrites every blamed line to use weights()/m_coefs and the source tensor basis; the diff context shows weights() returning basis().weights() and no data members.

defect: BlockTranspose::coeff/packet compute the source row and column with m_numBlocks instead of m_matrix.rows() and rows(), so they read the wrong entries.
reason: The fix replaces exactly the added index lines with colId % m_matrix.rows() and (colId/m_matrix.rows())*rows()+rowId, which follow from the rows()/cols() definitions in the diff.

defect: gaussSeidelSingleBlock builds the diagonal block as A.block(DoFs(i), DoFs(i)-i, 1, size), which is only correct for contiguous DoF blocks.
reason: The fix replaces the added line with elementwise A.coeff(DoFs(i),DoFs(j)) so that non-contiguous blocks work; the contiguity assumption is evident in the diff.

defect: The new constructor stores raw addresses of its const-reference arguments ({&composition,&function}), so the pointers dangle when it is called with temporaries.
reason: The fix replaces the blamed delegating constructor with clone()-based ownership plus a destructor freeing the copies.

defect: The new point-count formula ceil(n*L_i/prod(L)) is only right for unit domains (e.g. [0,2]x[0,1] with 100 points gives 10x5=50 points).
reason: The fix replaces the blamed lines the same day with h=(prod(L)/N)^(1/d) and npts=ceil(L/h).

defect: After switching to physBasisd2 from transformDeriv2Hgrad, the code still indexes it as physBasisd2(fct_i*d2_offsetter+j, k), but that result is numFuncs x numDers for a single point.
reason: The fix changes all the blamed accesses to physBasisd2(fct_i, j); the layout is documented only in gsGeometryEvaluator.h.

defect: The quadrature rule reads options.getInt("quA"), but quA is registered as a Real option, so the lookup fails at runtime.
reason: The fix changes the blamed line to getReal("quA"); the option type is declared in gsAssembler.hpp.

defect: The direct.h/getcwd define/unistd.h includes added for macOS later became unused.
reason: The fix only removes includes it calls unused (getcwd no longer appears in the file at the fix); the actual bug fixes are in other files.

defect: Swapping axes and reparametrizing in the constructor, with the 2/3 vertex-index handling tied to getOrient(), may rotate oriented patches wrongly.
reason: The fix restructures the class (index swap after swapAxis) and mainly adds computeTopology() calls in gsG1AuxiliaryPatch.h; the original logic may be equivalent, so it is unclear whether this file held the defect.

defect: None; the base aliases were named Base/BaseB.
reason: The fix only renames them to Base1/Base2 ('fix notation').

defect: Temporary debug-print block in precompute keyed on parameter value 0.25.
reason: The fix removes leftover debug output and changes SAME_ELEMENT flag handling elsewhere; deleting debug code is cleanup, not a repaired defect.

defect: segmentFromTo calls copy.insertKnot(u, mult), reported as ambiguous between gsBSpline::insertKnot and gsGeometry::insertKnot(knot, dir, i).
reason: The fix qualifies the call as copy.gsBSpline<T>::insertKnot, but under standard name hiding the unqualified call resolves to gsBSpline's overload, so the reported ambiguity is not confirmed.

defect: The local rhs matrices are zeroed with a single column, which breaks system.push with eliminated DoFs when the system has several rhs columns.
reason: The fix replaces the blamed setZero(rows,1) with setZero(rows, system.rhsCols()); the multi-rhs contract lives in gsSparseSystem.

defect: extractFull ordered coefficients patch-major instead of component-major, which breaks for multi-component multipatch solutions.
reason: The wrong ordering predates this change; 9d964b5 only added the GlobalIdentity nPatches shortcut, and those lines are touched incidentally.

defect: intersect used gsMatrix<T,2,1> for uv and evaluated with uv.row(i).
reason: At this commit compute() took gsMatrix<T,2,1>&, so the code was consistent; the fix is a type/style rework, and its real bug repairs are in gsCurveCurveIntersection.h.

defect: segmentFromTo used int for the degree and brace-style one-liners.
reason: The assigned fix e235a490 only changes types to silence warnings and reformats; the end-index bug in the blamed region was fixed earlier by a different commit (a3018dd2).

defect: The debug error handler is installed after MPI_Comm_rank/size rather than before.
reason: The fix reorders the calls and moves the init check under NDEBUG ('minors in gsMpiComm'), which is a refinement, not repair of a real defect.

defect: Commented-out block calls addLocalIndizesOfPatchSide, which a later API rename turned into addLocalIndicesOfPatchSide.
reason: The fix only renames the call to follow the later rename, and line 325 sits inside a /* */ block that 4eb5a06 added, so the code never runs. The fix repairs no defect.

defect: basisSlice hard-casts boundaryBasis() to a 1-D compact tensor basis, leaks the returned basis and passes a level count to the boundary constructor.
reason: The parent already had the same dynamic_cast, leak and constructor call. This commit only added const and typename, and the fix belongs to a later 'boundary objects' API rework.

defect: The ternaries `cond ? math::abs(m_gamma[i]) : 0` mix T and int, so they fail to compile for non-builtin coefficient types such as mpreal.
reason: The ternary lines are new in this file. The parent in gsSolverUtils.h used plain sums, and the fix only changes `0` to `T(0)` on those lines.

defect: insertKnot(T, index_t) is ambiguous with the inherited gsGeometry::insertKnot(T, index_t dir, index_t i=1) that `using Base::insertKnot` brings in.
reason: With the default index_t=int, changing int to index_t on line 214 changes nothing. The ambiguous call came from 115613e, and the fix redesigns the overloads (out-of-line definition, hidden private overload).

defect: slice() names gsTensorBSpline<d-1,T> and gsTensorBSplineBasis<d-1,...>. This commit also explicitly instantiates gsTensorBSpline<1,...>, so d drops to 0 and the build fails.
reason: The commit moved slice into the .hpp and added CLASS_TEMPLATE_INST for d=1 in gsTensorBSpline_.cpp. That instantiates every member, and the fix switches to BoundaryGeometry and the gsTraits boundary type so that d does not go to 0.

defect: gsInvDiagonalOp::make returns a uPtr of the concrete class, but callers need a gsLinearOperator shared pointer.
reason: The fix changes line 794 to return LinOpPtr inside a feature commit ('add matrix-free solving'), which is an API change. The real breakage (uPtr/Ptr typedefs still naming gsDiagonalOp) was repaired by an intermediate commit, 7c6fc7c.

defect: interpolateGrid now returns memory::unique_ptr, but the debug-only failure path still does `return 0;`, which does not compile with G+Smo's C++98 auto_ptr-based unique_ptr (explicit constructor).
reason: The commit changed the return type on line 909 from a raw pointer to unique_ptr. The fix replaces `return 0` with `return typename gsGeometry<T>::uPtr()` and restates the type. Seeing the error requires knowing that gsMemory.h's unique_ptr has an explicit constructor.

defect: In the autodiff paths, `const DScalar::Hessian_t & Hmat = expr.expression[c].value().getHessian();` binds a reference into a temporary returned by value(), so the reference dangles.
reason: dac0381 added these Hessian-reference lines (the parent had none), and the fix rebinds them through `const DScalar & ads = ...value();`. Most of the fix, the macro rename, is not a defect of this change.

defect: The MPI helper singleton is a function-local static in a header, so it can be duplicated across libraries. MPI_Init's return value is unchecked, and asserts vanish in release builds.
reason: This change only added const to argc and swapped assert for GISMO_ASSERT. The singleton design that the fix reworks (an exported gsMpiHelperSingleton) predates it.

defect: `std::max(calcDist(...)*0.01, std::pow(10.0, ...))` mixes T and double, so template deduction fails when T is long double.
reason: This commit added the std::max/std::pow line in place of the plain epsilon. The fix changes it to std::pow(T(10.0), ...) to support long double.

defect: reshape_expr::eval returns a gsAsMatrix view (reshape) of the temporary from _u.eval(k), so the view dangles. The constructor also asserts on rows()*cols() before any data exists.
reason: The whole class is new in this commit. The fix copies into a mutable tmp, returns a gsAsConstMatrix over it and moves the assertion into eval.

defect: The assertion nDofs==piece(k).size() rejects dof mappers with extra dofs, which the dG IETI branch allows (m_status |= 2).
reason: On stable at 20e5458 the equality held. It became wrong only after the merge with the dGieti3 branch (63bcbf6 was not an ancestor), and the fix relaxes it to >= after that merge.

defect: add(gsCompositionAd) does not register F∘(innerLeft∘innerRight). It keys the data on innerLeft's map data and ignores innerRight.
reason: The parent was already wrong: it keyed on m_fdata[innerLeft], not on the composition data. The fix, after several iterative 'bug composition' commits, rewrites the whole mechanism with a new key type.

defect: The serial element loop checks `!failed` redundantly, because the catch already breaks out.
reason: Removing `&& (!failed)` from the non-OpenMP loop changes no behaviour (break already exits, and the patch loop checks failed). The rest of the fix is indentation and comments.

defect: `dSigmadAlpha.conservativeResize(nControls,2)` is used as if it reshaped the result, but it only keeps the top-left block and leaves the new entries uninitialized, so dEdAlpha is wrong.
reason: This commit added the conservativeResize line (the parent had none). The fix replaces it with an Eigen::Map reshape of the same data.

defect: Leftover debug print `gsInfo << axisOrientation`.
reason: The fix only deletes a debug output line, which is a style cleanup and not a functional defect.

defect: clear() now resets m_dim=-1 and nboxes=0, but gsMultiPatch::computeTopology calls clear() and then uses m_dim (1<<m_dim) and the box count.
reason: This commit added the two lines, and the fix ('fix bug', half a day later) removes exactly them. The broken caller is in gsMultiPatch.hpp.

defect: `if(reducedG1BasisEdgeMap[numG1EdgeBasis[i-1]] == 0 || i == 0)` evaluates numG1EdgeBasis[i-1] with i==0 (size_t underflow) before the i==0 test, so it reads out of bounds.
reason: The whole reducedBasisEdgeMapper is new in this commit. The fix splits the i==0 case so that i-1 is only indexed when i>0.

defect: The general grad(divide_expr<E1,E2>) overload, now with an explicit return type, also matches or conflicts for constant numerators, and the fix restricts it to _expr<E1,false>.
reason: Line 253 was touched by this commit, but two intermediate commits ('improve mult_expr specializations', 'a better fix') changed the overload set before the fix. It is unclear whether the conflict comes from this change.

defect: The inexact MINRES residual update uses m_error *= sNew*sNew, but it should use |sNew|.
reason: `m_error *= sNew*sNew` already existed in the parent. This commit only reordered the statements.

defect: For several patches, m_numFreeDofs is wrongly multiplied by nPatches.
reason: The *nPatches factor was in the parent. This commit only changed numComp to numComp+1, and the fix removes the pre-existing factor.

defect: The outer normal's orientation sign comes from sign(det J) at each point, which flips wrongly where the Jacobian is singular or nearly so.
reason: This commit only moved the outer-normal block, with alt_sgn = sgn*(det<0?-1:1) unchanged, ahead of the measure. The fix replaces that pre-existing sign logic.

defect: none in the blamed line: the fix only reformats `m_fixedDofs.at(global_to_bindex(ii))`.
reason: The fix keeps this commit's .at(bindex) semantics on line 824 and only strips a comment and spacing. Its real change (corner bindex) is in lines this commit did not touch.

defect: The commit moved the explicit specialization gsXml<gsOptionList> from the header into the .cpp. Other translation units (for example gsCmdLine.h calling gsXml<gsOptionList>::get_into) then see the primary template, so the build breaks.
reason: The fix, 30 minutes later, moves the specialization back into gsOptionList.h, which removes exactly lines 509-523. Spotting it requires the header diff and the users in other files.

defect: `using Base::size;` in the 1-D gsTensorBasis specialization fails to compile on MSVC 2010.
reason: The fix ('bugfix msvc2010') replaces the using-declaration that this commit added. However, at dde1d74 that specialization was still inside a /* ... //*/ comment and only became live through later commits.

defect: detectTemp still refers to `temp` after the local variable was renamed to `_temp`.
reason: The mismatch was created by the later commit 2845044 ('warn fix'), which renamed the variables only partly. The fix completes that rename, and the str::string typo from this commit is left untouched by the fix.

defect: The constructor's manualLevels flag is not stored as a member.
reason: The fix adds a member m_manualLevels and initializes it everywhere, to support the later m_uIndices feature. Line 119's local `if (!manualLevels)` was correct as written.

defect: Leftover gsDebugVar debug prints in gsDirichletValuesByTPInterpolation.
reason: The blamed lines are debug prints, which the fix deletes. That is cleanup, not repair of a functional defect in these lines.

defect: The explicit instantiations of gsKnotRemove and gsTensorKnotRemove use index_t and gsVector<index_t>, but gsBoehm.h declares int and gsVector<unsigned>, so no template declaration matches.
reason: This commit added these instantiations. The fix ('fix integer type inconsistencies') changes them to the header's int and gsVector<unsigned> signature.

defect: The assertion is inverted: `2*p+1 > sz` fires for every valid knot vector and accepts too-short ones.
reason: This commit added the GISMO_ASSERT line, and the fix the same day flips > to <.

defect: The return statement this change added uses the nonexistent `gsMatrix<T>::uPt` instead of `uPtr`, so gsPointGrid fails to compile when instantiated.
reason: The fix changes only that added line, `uPt` to `uPtr`. The typo is plain in the diff.

defect: The added string literal "\%" uses an unknown escape sequence, which only produces a compiler warning.
reason: The fix replaces "\%" with '%'. GCC and MSVC still produce '%' and only warn, so this is a warning or style fix, not a functional defect.

defect: testEval prints an extra newline before "Result:".
reason: The fix only removes the leading \n from a debug print, a cosmetic change of mind.

defect: For surfaces, the outer normal is now signJk.cross(n) with the unnormalized normal n = t1 x t2, so its length is wrong (scaled by the area element). The normalized normal normalizedRes is still computed but left unused.
reason: The fix restores result = signJk.cross(normalizedRes) and removes the t1/t2/n lines this change added. The orientation tweak in the fix is separate, partly pre-existing work.

defect: The template-instantiation macros were later reorganized into separate *_EINST names for the extern-template scheme.
reason: The fix comes 48 days later, on an already restructured #ifdef _MSC_VER block, and renames the macros. It is a redesign, not a repair of a defect in this change's lines.

defect: The demangling code moved into gsUtils.h calls unqualified `free` in a header that includes no <cstdlib>, which can fail to compile under some C++11 setups.
reason: The lines were moved verbatim from gsJITCompiler.h, whose other includes probably supplied free. The fix only changes `free` to `std::free`, so it is unclear whether the move caused a real build failure.

defect: In the new elementInSupportOf, the box intersection takes the maximum for the upper corner where it needs the minimum (`>=` instead of `<=`), and it indexes sup(0,i)/sup(1,i) in the wrong order.
reason: The fix changes the upper-bound comparison to `sup(i,1) <= box.second[i]` in code this commit added. The comment "get intersection" makes the wrong max visible in the diff.

defect: An ad-hoc swap() with hard-coded patch indices 0..5 was added for testing.
reason: The fix simply deletes the test helper ("Some test" -> "Fixed"). That is removal of experimental code, not a repair of a demonstrated wrong result.

defect: Reading corner values now dereferences child->first_attribute("component") unconditionally, so existing XML <cv> nodes without a component attribute dereference null and crash.
reason: The fix makes component optional with a NULL check and a default of -1, repairing the line this change added. In the same file, the bc loop above already treats component as optional.

defect: The added preprocessor directive `#ifcc _OPENMP >= 202111` is invalid, so every build with OpenMP enabled fails.
reason: The fix corrects exactly that added line. The typo is directly visible.

defect: The ratio functions' namespace was later renamed, and a call was left as `utils::ratio`.
reason: At 57f1f6e the header and source both use namespace benchmark consistently. The broken utils:: reference came from the intervening commit c1895d2d7, and the fix finishes that rename.

defect: The new addLevel maps every new knot in a span to dirIndices[i]+1, so several knots inserted into one knot span get duplicate or wrong level indices. It also leaves gsDebugVar output in.
reason: The fix rewrites the extra-index loop in this newly added function: it counts the knots per span, chooses the middle index and updates the temporary knot vector. The single slot left after doubling the indices is visible in the diff.

defect: Narrowing the general divide overload to divide_expr<_expr<E1,false>,E2> makes it ambiguous with the divide_expr<E1,_expr<Scalar,true>> overload for variable/constant division.
reason: Ten minutes later the fix further restricts the second parameter of the same signature to _expr<E2,false>, removing the overlap this change created. Spotting it requires knowing the _expr/divide_expr types.

defect: toVTK builds its grid from funSet.basis(i).support(). basis() casts piece(i) to gsBasis, which is invalid when the function set is a multipatch of geometries.
reason: The fix replaces basis(i).support() with piece(i).support() on the blamed grid line. gsFunctionSet::basis() is a static_cast of piece(k), which only another file shows.

defect: After a later restructuring, matchWith's dynamic_cast<Self_t> no longer targets the right type.
reason: At dfe605b, Self_t is gsBSplineBasis and the cast is correct. The intervening 'some restructuring in bsplines' moved the code to gsTensorBSplineBasis<1>, so the fix to TensorSelf_t repairs that later change.

defect: BoundaryGeometryType and BoundaryBasisType are hard-coded to dimension 1 instead of d-1, so slice() is wrong (fails to compile) for d != 2.
reason: The fix changes the two added typedefs to gsHBSpline<d-1,T> and gsHBSplineBasis<d-1,T>. The doc comment's 'one less dimension' contradicts the hard-coded 1.

defect: The new fallback `return "Unknown-CPU ["+hostname+"]";` adds a char array to a string literal, which does not compile on non-x86_64 Linux.
reason: The fix replaces this added line with std::string concatenation. Pointer + pointer is visible in the diff.

defect: When removing updateElement, next() was rewritten as `if (isGood) isGood = nextLeaf();`, an inverted condition that skips to the next leaf after every element and never advances at the end of a leaf.
reason: The fix changes it to `if (!isGood)`. The comment 'went through all elements in m_leaf' and the removed else-branch make the inversion obvious.

defect: The piecewise-constant error vector assumes that element i of the uniformly refined degree-0 basis_0 corresponds to elwiseERROR[i].
reason: The old averaging loop already relied on that index mapping and on basis_0. The fix six days later is a broad rework: basis_0 from n_basis, domain-iterator ids, and new thresholding and marking. It does not repair a defect introduced by the simplification.

defect: For MinGW the change includes <intrin.h> to obtain __cpuid. The fix uses <cpuid.h> for GNUC instead, suggesting the intrin.h route did not build.
reason: MinGW support was already broken before this change. The commit was an attempted fix that the later commit replaced, and whether intrin.h actually failed can only be seen by building.

defect: The boundary workaround builds a fixed-size gsVector tmp2(2) and clamps only coordinate 1 near 1. 3D compositions are truncated, other boundary sides still give NaN, and debug output is printed.
reason: The fix sizes tmp2 by parDim(), adds the missing sides and the 3D cases, and removes the debug prints in exactly these blamed lines.

defect: No defect: the change mechanically replaces std::max/min with math::max/min.
reason: The fix is a large reformatting and type cleanup (#713). The blamed lines are only re-indented or retyped (gsMatrix uv to gsVector), not repaired.

defect: dfunc2->eval_into is changed to deriv_into.
reason: The parent already called dfunc2->eval_into. This change only added the f2param ? quNodes : values argument, so the blamed line is touched incidentally, and the fix's semantic change concerns pre-existing code.

defect: No defect: the intersect signature gained a curvatureTolerance parameter.
reason: The fix 59 days later (#713) reformats intersect and changes uv types. The new parameter line was not wrong.

defect: jacInvTr is resized to domDim*tarDim, which is wrong for dynamic dimensions (-1).
reason: The parent already had jacInv.resize(domDim*tarDim). This change only renamed the member to jacInvTr, so the size bug fixed by d*n predates it.

defect: The second function is evaluated with deriv_into although the caller supplies the gradient function, which the fix evaluates with eval_into. A debug print of f2ders is also left in.
reason: The parent already used deriv_into. Whether this change's new surface path changed the contract for func2 depends on the callers in the examples, so it is unclear whether the defect is new.

defect: insertKnot refers to nonexistent weight members (this->m_weights, tbs.m_weights).
reason: The tbs.m_weights compile error this change added was already repaired by the intervening commit 60aa63c ('few fixes 2'). The judged fix 322033d3 repairs that commit's this->m_basis.weights() and only restyles the gsBoehm lines from this change.

defect: Placing the #endif before `T thValue` leaves thValue declared but unused in builds without OpenMP.
reason: The fix moves #endif below thValue, which silences an unused-variable warning. The change itself fixed a missing #endif from the merge.

defect: The new breakPolylineIntoTwoParts uses the alternative token `and` (`!p1 and !p2`), which MSVC rejects by default, so the build fails on Windows.
reason: The fix replaces `and` with `&&` in that added line; its message notes that gcc accepted it.

defect: `gsQuadRule<T> & QuRule = *gsQuadrature::getPtr(...)` binds a reference to the object owned by a temporary unique_ptr, which is destroyed at the end of the statement. The reference dangles, and QuRule.mapTo is a use-after-free.
reason: The fix stores the returned uPtr in a variable and calls QuRule->mapTo. Spotting the dangling reference requires knowing that getPtr returns an owning uPtr by value.

defect: The stiffness visitor builds the local matrix from the parametric gradients (basisGrads) instead of the physical gradients (basisPhGrads) it has just computed.
reason: The file is new in this commit (no such code in the parent). The fix changes basisGrads.transpose()*basisGrads to basisPhGrads.transpose()*basisPhGrads. The diff shows the unused transformGradients result directly above the faulty line.

defect: No defect in the blamed lines: the change only replaced double with T in the quA parameter.
reason: The fix merges the two constructors into an init() with a default fixDir and adds an options-based constructor. That is a refactor plus a feature; the double->T change is kept.

defect: getOuterNormalDerivative evaluates the Jacobian at the opposite corner, because it maps parameters[d]==true (corner at the upper end) to supp(d,0) instead of supp(d,1).
reason: The function is new in this commit. The fix swaps the supp(d,0)/supp(d,1) selection. The same function uses parameter()?1:-1 (true = upper end) for the side normal, which exposes the inversion; the eps 1e-6->1e-4 part of the fix is only tuning.

defect: The OpenMP 4.0 'declare reduction' does not compile on MSVC (OpenMP 2.0), but that pragma existed before this change.
reason: The parent already had '#pragma omp declare reduction'. The change only renamed the struct and adjusted clauses, and the fix wraps the whole block in #ifndef _MSC_VER, so the incompatibility was not introduced here.

defect: A 'TODO: check here' hack returns early from foldoverElimination when the foldover energy is below 1e-5, which bypasses the loop's EPSILON=1e-20 convergence check and its error path.
reason: The block was added by this change and the fix deletes it. However, the fix's real repair is the pre-existing 'static const space' in gradObj_into, so removing the hack may be a change of mind rather than a defect fix.

defect: No functional defect: a default 'offset' argument was added to the virtual boundary(boxSide) overload, which the fix later renamed to boundaryOffset/allBoundary.
reason: The base class was updated consistently in the same commit. The fix only renames the members to avoid overload or default-argument confusion, which is an API refactor.

defect: No defect: the fix only reformats the 'if (isEnd) nL2 = copy.numCoefs();' line that this change introduced.
reason: In e235a49 the blamed line 117 is only split across two lines (styling); its semantics are unchanged.

defect: jacobian_into reshapes the derivative matrix to tarDim rows and block-transposes by domainDim. The derivative data is stored as domainDim x tarDim blocks, so non-square Jacobians come out wrong.
reason: The change replaced the old loop that reshaped (domDim,tarDim) and transposed. The fix changes it to resize(d, size/d) followed by blockTransposeInPlace(targetDim()). The removed old code in the diff shows the correct layout.

defect: With libstdc++ the code uses tr1 shared_ptr even in C++11 mode, and Intel is only routed to boost under GLIBCXX.
reason: The parent also used tr1 for every non-libc++/non-MSVC build, so the tr1-under-C++11 choice was pre-existing. The fix reorganises the preference, which is a change of mind, and adds an unrelated unique_ptr->shared_ptr conversion.

defect: The inner-knot DOF count is hard-coded to 3 and applied only when m_p-1-m_r==1, which gives wrong system sizes for other degree/regularity combinations.
reason: These lines were added by this change. The fix replaces them with the general condition m_p-m_r<innerKnotMulti+1 and the count 3*(m_r-1). Seeing that the count is wrong requires G1 domain knowledge.

defect: The fallback for a missing MPI_IN_PLACE is written backwards: '#define inout MPI_IN_PLACE' defines the macro inout instead of MPI_IN_PLACE, while the code later #undefs MPI_IN_PLACE.
reason: This change added the #ifndef MPI_IN_PLACE block. The fix swaps the macro to '#define MPI_IN_PLACE inout'. The mismatch with the #undef MPI_IN_PLACE is visible in the diff.

defect: The default active_into calls result.setConstant(0,u.cols()), which is Eigen's (size,value) form: it yields an empty matrix filled with u.cols() instead of a 1 x cols row of zeros.
reason: The file is new and the code did not exist in the parent. The fix changes the call to setConstant(1,u.cols(),0), and the comment 'single function 0 is active' states the intended result.

defect: Only leftover gsDebugVar debug printing in _makeUnique; no functional defect in the blamed lines.
reason: At the blamed lines the fix only deletes debug prints. The 'leak' it fixes concerns the copy/move constructors elsewhere.

defect: The multipatch is embedded into D-1 dimensions in basis_data; the later fix removes that.
reason: The embed(D-1) line was moved from the pre-existing laplace_beltrami. The other blamed lines (identity map) had already been rewritten by an intermediate commit (b8e773e) before the fix, so the blame is incidental.

defect: An unused direct.h include and getcwd macro.
reason: In this file the fix commit only removes unused inclusions; its bug fixes are in gsFunction.hpp and gsGeometryEvaluator.hpp.

defect: A debug gsInfo print was left in the intersection test, and the endpoint check is exact with no tolerance.
reason: The exact 0<=t<=bound comparison was already present before the change. The fix only adds a 1e-8 tolerance and removes the debug print, which is a style or behaviour tweak rather than a repair of a defect introduced here.

defect: A semicolon is missing after the 'typename gsPde<T>::Ptr pde(new gsLinpLapPde<T>(...))' declaration, so the header does not compile.
reason: The file is new in this commit, and the fix adds only the missing ';'.

defect: clone() calls addPiece(*piece(i).clone()), but addPiece clones its argument again, so every temporary clone leaks.
reason: This change added clone(), and the fix replaces the call with addPiece(piece(i)). addPiece's body, which calls func.clone(), is visible in the diff context.

defect: geoMap2vtk writes point coordinates with loops bounded by n, the number of patches, instead of pts.rows(), the coordinate dimension, which gives wrong or out-of-range output.
reason: geoMap2vtk is new in this commit. The fix replaces n with pts.rows() in both loops. The diff shows n = multiBasis().nBases() and the shadowed loop variable i.

defect: elementInSupportOf is added as a second, identical member declaration in gsRationalBasis (one already exists at line 148), which is a redeclaration compile error.
reason: The parent already had elementInSupportOf at line 148, and the fix deletes the duplicate added at line 217. The existing definition also appears in the function-context part of the reviewed code.

defect: getTempPath calls std::free on the pointer returned by getenv, which is an invalid free and can corrupt the heap.
reason: This change uncommented free(_temp) for the getenv branch. The fix removes it with the note 'env variable needs no free'. getenv is visible a few lines above.

defect: A leftover std::cout debug print in refineWithExtension.
reason: The fix ('Fix of Bugfix') only removes the debug print. This is cleanup with no functional repair.

defect: helper() uses 0 both as the 'unset' sentinel and as a valid local index. It also sizes 'which' by the global patch size while indexing it with the other patch's local-mapper index, which mixes index spaces and can give wrong or out-of-range constraints.
reason: helper() is new in this commit. The fix stores local index+1, subtracts 1 on read, asserts the result is >=0, and sizes 'which' by m_dofMapperLocal[otherPatch].freeSize(). Seeing the problem needs the gsDofMapper index semantics.

defect: Header hygiene only: <map> and gsExport.h are replaced by gsForwardDeclarations.h.
reason: gsExport.h already includes gsConfig.h, which provides real_t, so nothing failed to compile. The fix is an include cleanup.

defect: No defect: the toBezier code is only reindented and its braces restyled.
reason: e235a49 changes only the formatting of the blamed toBezier loop.

defect: No defect in the blamed intersect signature line.
reason: The fix only reformats the intersect() signature and body. The type changes in uv are unrelated to the line this change modified.

defect: Removing const from the input parameter of eval_into(gsMatrix<T>& u, ...) means it no longer overrides gsFunction::eval_into(const gsMatrix<T>&, ...); it becomes a hiding overload and virtual dispatch skips it.
reason: The diff shows this change dropping the const, and the fix restores it.

defect: The new apply1 clears m_elWise on every call, so when gsNormL2Boundary calls it once per boundary side, the element-wise values from earlier sides are lost.
reason: apply1 is new in this commit. The fix removes the clear from apply1 and moves it into gsNormL2Boundary::compute. Seeing this needs the per-side caller in the other file.

defect: The upper bound of the box intersection takes the max (>=) instead of the min, and debug prints were added.
reason: The wrong >= comparison was already present in the parent; this change only fixed the sup index order (0,i)->(i,0). The fix's switch to <= therefore repairs a pre-existing defect, and its other edits remove debug prints.

defect: The numPoints constructor computes npts[i]=ceil(span[i]/(h*span[i]/sum)) = ceil(sum/h), the same count in every direction, which gives a wrong total point count.
reason: The same formula existed in the deleted gsUniformGridIterator.h in the parent, so this change moved the defect rather than introducing it. The fix replaces the formula.

defect: The pybind cast of computeTopology names a (real_t,bool,bool) signature, which stopped compiling after a later header change.
reason: At 0f6253a gsMultiPatch.h declared computeTopology(T,bool,bool), so the 3-arg cast was correct. The signature became 2-arg in 2f64659e5 (2022-05-11), and the fix only follows that later change.

defect: deriv2Single_into replaced `m_is_truncated[i] == -1` with `isTruncated(i)` instead of `!isTruncated(i)`, which inverts the branch, so truncated functions take the plain tensor-basis path.
reason: This change wrote the inverted condition. The fix adds the missing `!`, and the sibling hunks in the same diff use `!isTruncated(i)` under the same 'not truncated' comment.

defect: The new operator+(expr, scalar) builds add_expr<_expr<Scalar>, E> but passes (u, constant) in the opposite order (a type mismatch), and the scalar-first overload puts the constant (rows()==0, null spaces) in the leading position.
reason: Both operator+ overloads were rewritten in this change. The fix (480381d5) reorders them to add_expr<E, constant>(u, constant), and the template/argument order mismatch can be read off the diff.

defect: The blamed lines are the quoted #warning text and an adjacent line, which the fix only reformats.
reason: The fix 418e19e6 drops the quotes from #warning, which is cosmetic, and swaps the pre-existing `#define inout MPI_IN_PLACE`. The real defect this change added, a duplicated #endif, was repaired earlier by 3f66d2bfd, not by this fix.

defect: constructSolution now takes dim = solVector.cols() instead of numRhs(), so when there are no free dofs (empty solution vector) dim is 0 and no coefficients, including the Dirichlet ones, are reconstructed.
reason: Line 539 (`const index_t dim = solVector.cols();`) is new in this change. The fix 'fix for no free dofs' falls back to m_ddof[unk].cols() when solVector.cols()==0, and knowing the vector can be empty needs the caller/solver side.

defect: initIteration has no early return when the initial residual is already below tolerance, which leads to a 0/0 later in step().
reason: The parent also applied the preconditioner and computed absNew with no such check. This change only renamed variables (line 29 is a renamed call), and the fix adds a new test, so the issue predates the change.

defect: The header renames the ratio() declarations to namespace `utils` while gsBenchmark.cpp still defines them in namespace `benchmark`, so utils::ratio has no definition and linking fails.
reason: This change edited the header namespace and the .cpp call sites but not the .cpp namespace block. The fix renames both the header (blamed lines 533/546) and the .cpp to `util`, and seeing the mismatch requires gsBenchmark.cpp.

defect: get() adds comp=-1 as 'all components' but filters with `c->m_unkcomp == comp || c->m_unkcomp == -1`, so the default call drops every component-specific BC.
reason: The filter line 406 is new. The fix changes it to `|| comp == -1`, and the regression shows in the diff because the old body returned all BCs for the unknown.

defect: degreeReduce is applied before uniformRefine instead of after, and the degree message is printed unconditionally.
reason: Degree reduction does not change the element count the loop compares, so the reorder in the fix (whose real subject is the density construction) is a rearrangement or change of mind, not a repaired defect.

defect: Removing the mesh-boundary free-DOF branch makes boundary corners with two or more incident faces an average of inner-point DOFs, so Dirichlet elimination constrains only their sum and the second row of control points can escape.
reason: This change deleted the is_boundary branch and introduced `face_count >= 2`. The fix restores a (shared) free DOF per boundary vertex and reverts to `face_count > 0`, and the consequence depends on how gsDofMapper::markBoundary eliminates DOFs.

defect: The new gsRefineMarkedFunctions counts marks only on patch 0 but loops over all of funMarked calling mp.basis(0).support(i) (out of bounds for multipatch), hardcodes block(...,2,2) (2D only), and uses std::bind2nd, which does not compile in C++17, instead of GS_BIND2ND.
reason: The whole function is new. The fix rewrites it per patch with poffset/globalCount and GS_BIND2ND, and GS_BIND2ND is used in the visible context of the same file (line ~311).

defect: setActive declares an outer `CMatrix cmat;` that the loop-local reference shadows and never uses.
reason: The fix only deletes the unused variable and renames shadowed `tb` variables, so it is warning cleanup, not a functional repair.

defect: The new gsField toVTK builds its grid from field.fields().basis(i).support(); through a gsFunctionSet reference, basis(i) static_casts piece(i) to gsBasis, which is wrong or asserts for multipatch and non-spline fields.
reason: Lines 162-173 are new (copied from the funSet overload). The fix switches to piece(i).support(), and seeing why basis(i) is wrong needs gsFunctionSet.hpp, where basis(k) casts piece(k).

defect: `case 1 ... 4:` is a GNU case-range extension that does not compile on MSVC.
reason: This change replaced the four separate case labels with the GNU range at line 1779, and the fix 'fix syntax' restores the separate labels.

defect: The new degreeDecrease lowers m_p but then calls increaseMultFirst/Last (copied from degreeIncrease) instead of reducing the end multiplicities.
reason: The function is new in this change. The fix replaces the increaseMult calls with trim(i), and the copy-paste is visible next to degreeIncrease in the diff.

defect: The sign declaration sits after factor1, and val is indexed linearly as val(i).
reason: For a 1xdim gsMatrix, val(i) and val(0,i) address the same entry, and moving the sign declaration changes nothing, so the fix is cosmetic.
