defect: The new pushSparse iterates gsSparseMatrix<T> localMat with gsSparseMatrix<double>::InnerIterator, which fails to compile for non-double T.
reason: Line 1201 is new in this change. The fix uses `typename gsSparseMatrix<T>::iterator`, and the hardcoded double inside a T-templated class is plain in the diff.

defect: Leftover gsDebugVar(dir/com/r) debug prints.
reason: Lines 107-109 only add debug output. The fix deletes them while also changing other, older lines, so for the blamed lines it is a cleanup.

defect: The duplicated corner-value loop in gsFeSpace::setup writes fixedDofs via bindex(i, patch, it->component), which ignores it->unknown and breaks for component -1, while gsDirichletValues already handles corners.
reason: This change only edited the bindex arguments (the parent's 4-arg call did not match the 3-arg bindex). The fix removes the whole pre-existing duplicate block, so it is unclear whether the repaired defect lies in the modified line or in the older block.

defect: Chi regularization for surfaces switched from option 1 to option 2.
reason: The fix switches again to option 3 (chi = detG, 'remove penalty'), which is a change of formulation, not a repair of wrong code.

defect: The copy constructor and operator= copy dim.
reason: Adding the dim copy was itself a correct fix. The later fix 0c0a4aab concerns a rewritten copy constructor (init(dim) before addComponent), and the blamed line is touched only through history.

defect: The explicit instantiation declarations (with T a macro, not a template parameter) use `typename gsGeometryEvaluator<T>::uPtr` and `typename gsBasis<T>::domainIter` outside a template, which is ill-formed in C++98.
reason: This change added the typename keywords when replacing auto_ptr. The fix 'no typename outside of templates' removes them, and the untouched line in the same diff already uses gsBasis<T>::domainIter without typename.

defect: getCoeffs assigns result.row(i) = solVector.row(ii) inside the per-component loop, but for dim>1 result has dim columns while solVector has one, so the sizes mismatch.
reason: Line 950 replaced `result(i,c) = solVector.at(ii)`. The fix restores it, and the mismatch is visible against the new resize(sz, dim!=1 ? dim : cols) and the loop over c.

defect: The stiffness assembly reinterpret_casts any basis to gsTensorNurbsBasis (UB for B-spline bases), and the mass and tilde-space code use a throw/catch bad_cast dispatch.
reason: The base compiled, with d a template parameter. The fix mainly reconciles a merge with upstream #319, where d became a runtime value, by calling basis.component(). The reinterpret_cast is a genuine UB that the fix removes, but it likely worked by luck, so the attribution is unclear.

defect: A library header includes the umbrella <gismo.h>.
reason: The fix only drops the umbrella include, which is header hygiene, not a functional defect.

defect: The OpenMP reduction is declared for `struct closestPointHelper` while the variable is `__closestPointHelper`, which fails to compile with OpenMP, and under default(shared) `tmp` is shared across threads, which is a data race.
reason: Lines 730-738 are new. The fix renames the type in the declare reduction and makes tmp private, and both problems are visible in the diff.

defect: Changing `const boundary::side & side1 = bi[0].side()` to `const boxSide &` binds a reference into the temporary patchSide returned by const operator[], which dangles, and the change also dropped the gsDofMapper.h include.
reason: Lines 110/111 and the include removal are this change's. The fix uses bi.first().side() and re-adds the include, and seeing that operator[] returns by value while side() returns a reference requires gsBoundary.h.

defect: The new coefficient scaling adds (sum of the other coefficients)/coef[k] instead of coef[k]/coef[neighbour], so the jumps get the inverted rho-scaling (weighted by the patch's own coefficient), and the per-row sum breaks with corner primals.
reason: setupCoefficientScaling is new. The fix ('works now for 2d with corner primals') tracks the neighbouring patch per row and inverts the ratio, and catching the inverted weight needs IETI scaling theory or testing.

defect: Duplicate vertex pointers are erased after std::unique without being freed, which leaks memory.
reason: The parent already did sort/unique/erase without freeing. This change only moved the erase and added debug output, so the leak the fix addresses with cleanStlMesh predates it.

defect: np2 is computed as `np.size()>1 ? np(2)-1 : 0`, which reads out of bounds for 2D grids where np has two entries.
reason: Line 293 is new. The replaced code used `np.size()>2`, and the fix restores that guard.

defect: The new pruned() lambda calls abs(x) unqualified on Scalar without `using std::abs`, so inside Eigen's namespace it does not resolve to std::abs and the C++14 build breaks.
reason: The fix adds `using std::abs;` and a return-type spec to the pruned() lines this commit added; an unqualified abs on a template Scalar can be seen in the diff.

defect: No concrete defect: prepending './' to a bare relative path is harmless; the fix comments out the later getCurrentPath() variant from 5d90b33.
reason: The './' body this commit added had already been replaced by 5d90b33 before the fix. The fix only comments out the condition line, which here is touched incidentally.

defect: Work-in-progress code: isBdy is a hard-coded {true,true} placeholder, and isBoundary/checkBoundary are empty stubs.
reason: The fix implements the planned boundary detection (checkBoundary, swapBdy, per-patch isBdy), so it completes a feature rather than repairing a defect.

defect: The overloads addCornerValue(int p, boxCorner c, T v, int u) and addCornerValue(boxCorner c, T v, int u) are ambiguous for normal 3-argument calls such as (0, boundary::southwest, 1.0) or (boundary::southwest, 0.0, 0), because boxCorner converts implicitly from int and from boundary::corner.
reason: The fix merges the two overloads this commit added into one, addCornerValue(boxCorner c, T value, int p=0, int unknown=0). Seeing the ambiguity requires boxCorner's converting constructors in gsBoundary.h.

defect: In the combineCorners branch of allComponents, the loop pushes it->second[i] (the outer dimension index, always 0) instead of it->second[j], and the collected `last` vector is never added to result.
reason: The fix changes [i] to [j] and adds result.push_back(last), both in code this commit added; both errors can be seen in the diff.

defect: The constructor hard-codes m_dbd = {0}, so every Kronecker matrix treats DoF 0 as a Dirichlet DoF and apply/diagonal_into return wrong results.
reason: The fix deletes the m_dbd.resize(1); m_dbd(0)=0 lines (marked FOR TESTING) that this commit added; the leftover test hack sits in the constructor shown in the diff.

defect: slice() uses gsTensorBSpline<d-1>/gsTensorBSplineBasis<d-1>, which drops to dimension 0 for d=1.
reason: The fix adds a BoundaryGeometry typedef via choose<d==1,...>, but the parent's stub slice already used gsTensorBSpline<d-1>. Five intermediate commits (including a template-parameter refactor) make it unclear whether this commit caused the break.

defect: For dim==1, hessian_into now assigns secDers.transpose(), which gives an N x targetDim result instead of 1 x N when there are several points.
reason: The fix replaces the whole hessian_into body with util::secDerToHessian inside a commit about computeAuxiliaryData, so it is unclear whether it targets the transpose or is a refactor.

defect: The corner-value fixedDofs override block is removed by the fix; this commit only corrected the bindex argument list inside it.
reason: The block existed in the parent (where the 4-argument bindex call did not even match the 3-parameter signature). The fix deletes the whole pre-existing block together with an XML default change, so it does not repair this commit's edit.

defect: The pybind static_cast to bool(Class::*)(real_t,bool) stopped matching after computeTopology gained a third bool parameter.
reason: At 0fe3e14, gsMultiPatch.h declares computeTopology(T tol, bool cornersOnly), so the cast was correct; the signature changed later.

defect: No confirmed defect: the fix reverts the fixed-part branch of solGrad_expr to the old row().asDiagonal()/replicate form and leaves eval unchanged.
reason: The partial revert is inconsistent with the per-component mapper this commit introduced and looks like a merge or change of mind; the blamed extractFull lines are not changed by the fix.

defect: The pybind static_cast to gsMatrix<real_t>(Class::*)(int) const matches no greville overload (greville(bool) returns gsMatrix, greville(int) returns T), so the Python build fails.
reason: At this commit gsKnotVector.h declares gsMatrix<T> greville(bool clamp) and T greville(int); the fix changes the cast to (bool).

defect: The new insertKnot uses this->m_weights (no such member in gsTensorNurbs; weights live in gsRationalBasis) and calls size_cwise/component on the rational basis, so it does not compile when instantiated.
reason: Three follow-up compile fixes (d9e2f2d, 60aa63c, then this fix) rewrite the same added lines. Spotting it requires the class and basis declarations from other files.

defect: BlockTranspose::coeff and packet compute the source row and block from colId using m_numBlocks instead of m_matrix.rows(), so they read the wrong entries unless rows equal numBlocks.
reason: The fix replaces the index arithmetic with colId % m_matrix.rows() and (colId/m_matrix.rows())*rows()+rowId in the class this commit added; the arithmetic can be checked in the diff.

defect: Relative paths are now turned into absolute paths with getCurrentPath(), which the fix disables by commenting the branch out.
reason: The fix comments out exactly this commit's getCurrentPath() line with the message 'fix for paraview', but the failure it addressed (presumably absolute paths breaking ParaView output) is not stated or visible.

defect: gaussSeidelSingleBlock builds the diagonal block as A.block(DoFs(i), DoFs(i)-i, 1, size), which is only correct when the block's DoFs are consecutive; for any other blocking the result is silently wrong.
reason: The fix replaces this with Dblock(i,j)=A.coeff(DoFs(i),DoFs(j)). The class is meant for arbitrary blocking patterns, and the contiguity assumption can be seen in the diff.

defect: The new constructor stores raw pointers to its const-reference arguments ({&composition,&function}), which dangle if temporaries are passed.
reason: The fix switches to cloned, owned functions with a destructor; the lifetime hazard can be seen in the diff, but whether a caller actually passed temporaries is not shown.

defect: The number of points per direction is computed as ceil(n/prod(L) * L_i) with n = N^(1/d), which is dimensionally wrong (for example L=(2,2), N=100 gives 5x5 instead of 10x10).
reason: The fix, on the same day, replaces it with h=(prod(L)/N)^(1/d) and npts=ceil(L/h), rewriting exactly the lines this commit added.

defect: physBasisd2 from transformDeriv2Hgrad(k,...) is an N x d(d+1)/2 matrix for point k, but the code indexes it as physBasisd2(fct_i*d2_offsetter+m, k), the layout of basis2ndDerivs.
reason: The fix changes the indexing to physBasisd2(fct_i, m) in lines this commit added; seeing the error requires the output layout of transformDeriv2Hgrad.

defect: Reads the quadrature option with options.getInt("quA"), but quA is registered as a Real option, so the lookup fails at runtime.
reason: gsAssembler.hpp at this commit has opt.addReal("quA",...), and the fix changes the call this commit added to getReal.

defect: The getcwd/_getcwd macro and the unistd/direct includes became unused.
reason: The fix ('remove unused inclusion') drops them after later code stopped using getcwd; this is cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: Reparametrization is restructured (the 2/3 vertex-index swap replaces the swapped switch cases), with the actual fix being computeTopology after swapAxis in gsG1AuxiliaryPatch.h.
reason: The rewritten rotation logic in this file is equivalent to the original; the real repair is in another file, so this file's change is a restructuring.

defect: No defect: the alias names Base/BaseB are renamed to Base1/Base2.
reason: The fix only renames the alias names.

defect: Leftover debug block in precompute that prints map data via gsDebug whenever a point equals 0.25.
reason: The fix removes leftover debug output (only active in debug builds) and mainly changes SAME_ELEMENT flag handling; it is cleanup, not a repair of wrong results.

defect: copy.insertKnot(u1, multEnd) was reported as ambiguous between gsBSpline::insertKnot and gsGeometry::insertKnot.
reason: gsBSpline declares insertKnot without a using-declaration, so name hiding should prevent standard C++ ambiguity; the fix follows an 'ambiguity test' commit, and no real compile error can be confirmed.

defect: localToGlobal pushes with local RHS blocks fixed at one column (setZero(rows,1)), which breaks systems with several right-hand-side columns.
reason: The fix sizes the local RHS with system.rhsCols() in lines this commit added; seeing it requires the multi-RHS contract of gsSparseSystem::push.

defect: extractFull uses the wrong offset ordering for several components on several patches.
reason: The broken offset logic already existed in the parent; the fix keeps this commit's GlobalIdentity nPatches logic and only reorders the loops.

defect: The fix changes the type of uv from gsMatrix<T,2,1> to gsVector<T,2> and builds the evaluation points explicitly.
reason: At this commit gsCurveCurveDistanceSystem::compute takes gsMatrix<T,2,1>&, so the code was consistent. The fix's changes in this file are type and style changes; the actual bug fix is in gsCurveCurveIntersection.h.

defect: The fix's changes to segmentFromTo are int-to-short_t type changes and reformatting.
reason: The real nL2 end-parameter correction was made by an intermediate commit; e235a490 only changes types and style on the blamed lines.

defect: Minor reorder: the errhandler is set before rank/size, and the initialization check moves under NDEBUG.
reason: The fix's changes to this commit's lines are cosmetic reordering; the MPI_IN_PLACE macro fix concerns lines this commit did not add.

defect: The constructor now makes m_filename absolute by prefixing gsFileManager::getCurrentPath(), but gsParaviewCollection::addDataSet (in gsParaviewCollection.cpp) prepends getCurrentPath() to getPath(m_filename) again. The doubled base path makes makeRelative produce wrong DataSet file paths in the .pvd.
reason: Commit 5d90b33 replaced `path = "./" + path` with `path = gsFileManager::getCurrentPath() + path` on blamed line 96, and the fix 469e9dd comments that line out, so the defect is in the changed line. Seeing the breakage needs addDataSet in gsParaviewCollection.cpp, which builds `getCurrentPath() + getPath(m_filename)` and so assumes m_filename is relative.
